name: Kanab Town Loop
note: An easy spin round Kanab under the Vermilion Cliffs: up 100 East past the shops, across 300 North, down the old highway and out along Kanab Creek Drive, home on 100 East

name: Kolob Terrace Climb
note: The big one: 390 m up US 89 through Kanab Creek Canyon, between the Vermilion and White Cliffs, to the summit at 1,877 m — and the long descent home the same way

name: Hoodoo Rim & the Tunnel
note: From the summit beside Hoodoo Rim down through the galleried Kanab Creek Tunnel, then back up the BLM 48 track above it and over County Road 43: a loop, not the same road twice

name: Coral Pink Dunes Loop
note: Hancock Road to the Coral Pink Sand Dunes: along the dunes road, a loop past its end on the BLM 33A and 32B tracks, back through the dunes on the Ford Road trail and Dune Access Road, home by County Road 43 and Hancock Road

name: Butte Valley Gravel
note: Monument Valley's mittens and Merrick Butte over the sage: east on US 89 under the buttes, round the Vermillion subdivisions to Johnson Canyon, back west and out round the Eight Mile Gap gravel loop

name: Little Hollywood & the Old Adobe
note: From Kanab out US 89 east, round Bryce Canyon Way and Kaibab Trail, the BLM 105 tracks past the old adobe ruin, up Johnson Canyon Road to the movie set and back, home under the buttes on Rock Ledge, Red Cliffs and Pine Cliffs

name: Vermilion Cliffs Rollers
note: Out along US 89 east under the Vermilion Cliffs past Butte Valley to Johnson Canyon, and back

name: Arch Garden Circuit
note: Hancock Road to the Arch Garden: out on the BLM 62H track along the bench, round the arches on the BLM 66 tracks and County Road 43, and home down Hancock Road

name: Sand Spring Climb
note: Off Hancock Road up the sandy Sand Spring track through the juniper to 1,914 m, and back down

name: Hoodoos, Tunnel & Back Tracks
note: The big loop from Kanab: up US 89, onto the BLM 106 tracks through the hoodoo field, down through the galleried tunnel, back up the long BLM 48 track and County Road 43, and home down the canyon

name: Vermilion Cliffs Trails
note: Kanab's own trails: K-Hill and Toms Canyon under the cliffs, then the Cliffs Trail climb, 190 m up to the rim and back, home through town
